t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each color gnome matches a color basket. Brown, green, and yellow matches the yellow basket. Blue and purple matches the purple basket. stay with the basket that is giving you most until it decreases by 1-2 then switch to the other color basket

vb_textbox.text: There are 6 gnome colors in this game and two different basket colors. Brown, red, and pink gnomes will bring up the red basket. Green, yellow, and blue gnomes will bring up the yellow basket. Pick one basket color to start with and continue picking the gnomes associated with the basket until you see a decrease in mushrooms. Once you see too much of a decrease swith to the opposite basket color.
